messages.author: Liam
messages.content_text:
apr 29 Notes:


Today was fomc and it was an unfortunate day for me because there were potential trades I would have taken, but I missed them again and again.
,
Market opened and we instantly saw lower like I expected into the ote of the range, sweeping engineered liquidity. A 3min rb formed and made an smt with es and this would have caught the low of nyam and price rallied up, offered different entries that I never got in on. I waited for 10:00 and it continued to rally and form nicely for a retracement into the range and long. I was hoping nq would form relative equal highs and retrace for 10:00 longs, but kept going up so I got off of the chart. If I had waited, price would have came down and hit 10:00, lined up with discount of the range, and given a perfect entry to the tick for a winning trade. Exactly what a 10:00 setup should look like because we had a 5min and 1min gap line up with it too. If I was trading micros, I probably would have been stopped in profit or at break even because we didn’t tap swing highs, but with a full mini I would have hit a max profit tp. (Screenshot 1-3)
,
Later in the day we had smt’s at basically every low and nq didn’t take any of the lows and that should have been an indication we were going higher. The setup I could have taken was a 5min rb and it had engineered liquidity, and it could have worked as a limit, or a 1min rb out of the rb. (Screenshot 4 & 5)
,
I missed that last trade because I had tunnel vision on a lower rb from the 5min in the nyam session. We had a bunch el and I thought that is what we would get, but I was so focused in on it that I missed the other one that formed right under my nose. (Screenshot 6)
,

messages.content_text:
apr 28 Notes:


I took two losing trades today, one in the an and one in the pm session. I was somehow off side for both sessions. Must just not be my day.
,
The overnight session had dumped coming into market open and the bottom had rejected off of a daily ob, and we were in a daily fvg. We are also at all time highs so my bias for the day was bullish. I was looking at trades, but ultimately I waited for 10:00 and we instantly manipulated lower, made a 5min rb and traded higher. This move turned the 10:00 5min candle into an ob, which I entered off of. We got a little move up, but barely anything and I was basically wrong on the day because we dumped after. What I could have done differently with this trade is wait for a little more of a move higher off of 10:00, but this is what has been playing out for the last few days. (Screenshot 1)
,
The second trade I took was in pm and I wasn’t going to, but the risk was so low and I thought my conviction there to work. My draw was lower because we had stacked lows and we edged Fridays untapped nwog. I saw an amd and a 30min fvg above it that aligned with the 0.5. Price traded above the el, and although the 5min rb didn’t close bullish, the 1min rejected for the 0.5 level with an smt at the el. I entered off of it because it was 7pts of risk on 5 micros. (Screenshot 2 & 3)
,
I think that the problem today may have been that I wasn’t trading very intelligently, I was offside for both trades. I don’t have much else to say, if they played out. I don’t think I would have questioned why or thought it was luck, so not too upsetting.
,

Two trades a day, if it’s a W close laptop, if its a L I can risk again with less risk (75 first trade 50 second trade). Second lose, close laptop and tape read pa after the gym. If its BE you can look for re entry if DOL is still intact. BE is also a trade.

Risk 12.5% of max drawdown per trade, as I’m not super confident in myself, I want to give myself 8 trades before blowing.
,


Journal all trades in this channel, even non trading days.
,


Journal your emotions everyday, also after the trades.
,


Chase this dream like there is no tomorrow nigga.
